title: Clean a car battery's tapered post with a terminal brush
instruction: Scrub all coating off the negative battery post with the brush's internal bristles, then return the brush to its starting place.
context: Auto mechanics scrub battery posts during isolated bench service, as when a battery is out of the vehicle for charging, testing or storage.The internal wire brush must sit squarely over a tapered SAE post and twist under load; a stationary press removes nothing. A dry chalk-marker coat provides a repeatable visible corrosion stand-in, testing real grasp, alignment, load and sweeping rather than lead chemistry. The dust cap starts off beside the tool. The low-profile sealed battery stays strapped in its tray; it is not drained, so treat it as charged. Its positive terminal stays covered, 134 mm from the negative post, more than the 120 mm tool length, so the brush cannot bridge the terminals.Sacrificial pad covers keep wire and dry debris off the pads. The external cone is present as part of the ordinary two-ended tool but is not an objective.
setup: Coordinates in mm from the midpoint between arm bases: x forward, y left, z above the bench. Retired intact sealed ODYSSEY ODS-AGM28L PC925 battery, Group 28, 168 x 175 x 127 mm case, 10.8 kg, strapped in an Attwood 9092-5 tray (279.4 x 177.8 mm internal). Battery centre (307,-147), tray base on bench, 3 mm thick (estimate). Fit brass Odyssey 3217-0006 SAE adapters (28 mm overall); the negative taper starts at (240,-220,132), 17.9 mm base, 15.9 mm top, 18 mm high, 1:9 taper. The positive terminal stays under its supplied insulating cover. Osborn 0008493100 brush, 120 mm long, 65 mm external bristle trim, cone 15-25 mm diameter; estimated 35 mm plastic body, 90 g uncapped. It stands cup-down at (230,-365), cap already removed and lying horizontally beside it, open end at (310,-340,19.5), axis along +x (estimated 38 mm diameter, 75 mm long, 30 g). Mark the post taper with one opaque coat of edding 4095 black chalk marker, including all scored patches; dry at least 1 minute and until a dry swab does not pick up wet ink. Pad covers: sacrificial 0.25 mm polyurethane under nitrile covers. Grippers touch only the cap and plastic brush body. The tray catches brushing debris. The README gives complete source/estimate checks, the preparation/reset recipe.
scoring: Post-only. P is the clean fraction of the initially coated taper (72 patches: 24 around x 3 bands), from close start/end photos and video. Every nonzero tier requires cup seating for >=1 continuous second: rim 129-142 mm above bench (>=8 mm below post top), within 3 mm coaxial offset and 10 degrees tilt. Any gripper-link contact with the taper during the trial scores 0, even after cleaning (video). Also 0 if brush/cap falls below bench or P=0. Otherwise apply in order: 1.0 if P>=95%, brush released and still on bench within 40 mm of start, both hands 30 mm clear; 0.75 if P>=75%; 0.5 if 50%<=P<75%; 0.25 if 0<P<50%. Full cleaning without return is 0.75; doing nothing is 0. Use video for hidden sides; no real-trial force readings.
reset_notes: About 3 minutes. Brush debris into the tray; damp-wipe the post away from the robot and dry. Apply one opaque coat of edding 4095 black to the full taper, wait at least 1 minute and until dry to a clean swab. Leave the cap off, lying at (310,-340), axis +x; stand uncapped brush cup-down at (230,-365). Keep battery strapped, other terminal covered. Replace torn/dirty covers (0.25 mm sacrificial polyurethane under nitrile), wipe tray, photograph coated start, arms ready. No liquid, loose powder or debris touches pads. Marker $5.15, estimated coating under $0.10/reset plus covers. Use an intact sealed retired PC925; never open/drain it or use a leaking/damaged battery. Use clean brass SAE adapters as the non-lead stand-in; never brush bare lead or actual corrosion. Catch residue in tray, damp-wipe and replace pad covers.
fidelity: Coating rule: each patch needs 20 mm tangential bristle sweep at >=2 N total radial spring load, >=0.25 N/sector. Four physical spring sectors replace wires; only colours change. Every credit requires 1 s cup seating; only bristle sweep cleans (fingers cannot); gripper/taper contact fails (video). Dry marker on brass SAE adapters stands in for corrosion. Body/cap/profile, masses, springs/friction are estimates with ruler/scale checks. Cap starts detached, no retention. Full-size unused cone.
